units.source_text: 七段的这个毛病，成了围棋杂志的杂谈栏和漫画栏的好材料。

en.t: This habit of the seventh-dan player became perfect material for the chat columns and comic strips in go magazines.

units.source_text: 曾有过这样的报道：一盘棋中走了那么多趟，恐怕沿着东海道走的话，都可以到达三岛驿站了。

en.t: There was even a report like this: with all the trips he made during a single game, if he had been walking along the Tokaido, he probably could have reached the Mishima post station.
